verdict.rationale: First-party material positions debugging as a core use: 'Build, debug, and ship', a 'Debug live web applications' Chrome integration, piping logs into the tool, overnight CI failure analysis, and turning Slack bug reports into PRs. All of this is driven by plain-language, natural-language commands. Community reports that its self-verification is unreliable lower confidence but do not concretely contradict the debugging capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the debugging and troubleshooting workflow (the evidence is mostly taglines and headings), and independent hands-on corroboration of debugging success.
